description: This file defines a static utility class 'BitStreamFormatter' in the 'Orleans.Serialization.Utilities' namespace. It provides methods for formatting binary-encoded or serialized data buffers into a human-readable textual format for debugging or analysis purposes.

classes.name: BitStreamFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to format and visualize encoded bitstreams into human-readable strings for debugging and analysis.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a generic reader buffer into a string. Overloaded for different input types such as buffers, arrays, streams, etc.

methods.name: FormatField
methods.description: Helper method that formats individual fields of the serialized data based on their wire type, including handling references, nested structures, and byte arrays.

methods.name: FormatByteArray
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a human-readable string, choosing ASCII representation if possible, otherwise hex.

methods.name: FormatFieldHeader
methods.description: Formats the header information of a field, including ID, schema type, and extended type details.

methods.name: FormatTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Recursively formats a tag-delimited field, used when serializing nested objects or structures.

methods.name: AppendAddress
methods.description: Appends formatted address (memory position) information of the reader to the string builder.
